title: 第4章 操作失误了-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    对方的信息，只有一串数字编号，连个头像都没有。

    在这诡异的世界里，陌生人带来的危险，往往比黑夜里的怪物更令人胆寒。

    片刻的迟疑后，他还是点了通过申请。

    【编号36454160：大佬救命！那瓶花酿能不能先借我顶一顶？我理智马上清零，周围已经全黑了，我发誓明天凑够幸存点绝对双倍还你！】

    许默心生嗤笑。

    借？

    这种虚无缥缈他实在太熟悉了。

    冰冷的现实世界里，他曾经为了给重病的亲人凑救命钱，敲开过一扇扇亲戚的门，那时他听过的冷嘲热讽、看过的刻薄嘴脸，比这三言两语要残酷一百倍。

    在生死边缘谈信用，简直是天大的笑话。

    【许默：不借。】

    干脆利落的两个字发过去，没有丝毫商量的余地。

    本以为对方会知难而退，或者干脆破口大骂，没想到聊天界面很快又闪烁起来。

    【编号36454160：别啊大佬！求求你别关聊天框！那以物换物行不行？我拿全部家当跟你换！】

    许默放在关闭按钮上的手指猛地悬停。

    频道私聊是需要消耗理智值的。

    对方明知理智即将枯竭，却还要顶着彻底崩溃的风险疯狂发消息，这分明是垂死挣扎。

    既然对方穷途末路，连全部家当都愿意送了，看看也无妨。

    【许默：截图发来看看。】

    叮叮叮几声轻响，几张色彩暗淡的图片接连弹了出来。

    枯草、残缺的树杈、几块灰扑扑的石头。

    一堆毫无价值的破烂。

    许默眉头紧紧拧在一起，刚准备抬手切断通讯，视线却忽然凝固在最后一张图片的角落。

    在一堆废料边缘，挨着半个生锈的破铁罐和装水的容器旁，赫然装着一坨黏稠透亮的半流淌状物体，外面还严严实实裹着几片宽大的翠绿叶子。

    蜂蜜？

    许默瞳孔骤然收缩。

    【许默：你有蜂蜜？交易行里怎么从来没见你挂过？】

    【编号36454160：我挂了啊！标价20幸存点，挂了一整个下午都没人看一眼！现在大家连一口干净水都喝不上，谁有闲心去买这种甜腻腻的累赘玩意儿！大佬你要是能看上，我全给你打包发过去！】

    许默深吸一口气，强行压下心头的狂喜。

    普通人拿蜂蜜当累赘，可他不一样。

    他的天赋是【酿酒师】。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The other party’s information only contains a series of numbers, not even an avatar.

In this weird world, the dangers brought by strangers are often more frightening than monsters in the night.

After a moment’s hesitation, he still clicked to approve the application.

【No. 36454160: Boss, help!Can you lend me that bottle of flower wine first?My sanity was cleared immediately, and everything around me was completely dark. I swear I will repay you twice as much as I can if I gather enough survival points tomorrow!】

Xu Mo laughed heartily.

borrow?

This kind of emptiness is all too familiar to him.

In the cold real world, he once knocked on the doors of relatives in order to collect life-saving money for his seriously ill relatives. The cynicism he heard and the mean faces he saw at that time were a hundred times crueler than these few words.

Talking about credit on the edge of life and death is simply a big joke.

【Xu Mo: I won’t borrow it.】

Sent two words, without any room for negotiation.

I thought that the other party would give up, or simply curse, but I didn’t expect that the chat interface would flash again soon.

【No. 36454160: Stop it, boss!Please don't close the chat box!Is it okay to exchange things for things?I'll give you all my belongings in exchange!】

Xu Mo’s finger on the close button suddenly hovered.

Channel private chats require sanity points.

The other party knows that their sanity is about to run out, but they still send messages frantically at the risk of complete collapse. This is clearly a desperate struggle.

Since the other party is at the end of his rope and is willing to give away all his belongings, it doesn’t hurt to take a look.

【Xu Mo: Send the screenshot for a look.】

“Ding ding ding” made a few soft sounds, and several dimly colored pictures popped up one after another.

Withered grass, broken tree branches, and a few gray stones.

A pile of worthless junk.

Xu Mo’s brows were knitted together. He was about to raise his hand to cut off the communication, but his eyes suddenly froze at the corner of the last picture.

On the edge of a pile of scraps, next to half a rusty tin can and a water container, there was a thick, translucent, semi-liquid object, tightly wrapped with a few broad green leaves.

Honey?

Xu Mo’s pupils suddenly contracted.

【Xu Mo: Do ​​you have honey?Why have I never seen you fail in the trading house?】

【No. 36454160: I'm dead!The price was listed at 20 survival points, but no one even looked at it the whole afternoon!Nowadays, everyone can’t even drink a sip of clean water. Who has the time to buy such sweet and cumbersome stuff?Boss, if you like it, I will package it all and send it to you!】

Xu Mo took a deep breath and suppressed the ecstasy in his heart.

Ordinary people regard honey as a burden, but he is different.

His talent is [Winemaker].
